description: Fixed Leader metadata for pyadps v1.0.0. Includes raw fields and decoded bit-field derivatives for xarray.Dataset integration.
source: WorkHorse ADCP Commands and Output Data Format (RDI Specification), Section 5.2, Page 126-131

0.name: fixed_leader_id
0.description: Identifier for Fixed Leader data structure (0x007F = 127).

1.name: cpu_version
1.description: Contains the version number of the CPU firmware.

2.name: cpu_revision
2.description: Contains the revision number of the CPU firmware.

3.name: system_configuration_code
3.description: 16-bit coded field defining the WorkHorse ADCP hardware configuration. Contains frequency, beam pattern, sensor config, and other system settings packed in individual bits.
3.comments: Raw bit-coded configuration. See decoded_fields for individual parameters.

4.name: real_sim_flag
4.description: Indicates whether the data is real (collected) or simulated test data.

5.name: lag_length
5.description: Time period between sound pulses. Used in ping timing configuration (WM5, WM8, WM11, BM7 commands).

6.name: num_beams
6.description: Number of beams used to calculate velocity data. WorkHorse needs 3 beams minimum for velocity; 4th beam provides error velocity.
6.comments: Typically 4 for full error velocity calculation

7.name: num_cells
7.description: Number of depth cells (bins) over which the ADCP collects velocity data.

8.name: pings_per_ensemble
8.description: Number of pings averaged together during a data ensemble.

9.name: depth_cell_length
9.description: Physical length of one depth cell.

10.name: blank_after_transmit
10.description: Blanking distance allowing transmit circuits to recover before receive cycle.

11.name: profiling_mode
11.description: Signal processing mode used by the ADCP.

12.name: low_correlation_threshold
12.description: Minimum correlation threshold for water-profile data quality.

13.name: number_code_repetitions
13.description: Number of code repetitions in the transmit pulse.

14.name: percent_good_minimum
14.description: Minimum percentage of water-profiling pings that must be good to output velocity data.

15.name: error_velocity_maximum
15.description: Maximum error velocity threshold. If exceeded, water-current data flagged as bad.
15.comments: WE command sets error velocity threshold

16.name: time_per_ping_minute
16.description: Minutes portion of time between ping groups in ensemble.
16.comments: Part of TP command (time per ping)

17.name: time_per_ping_second
17.description: Seconds portion of time between ping groups in ensemble.
17.comments: Part of TP command (time per ping)

18.name: time_per_ping_hundredth
18.long_name: Time Per Ping - Hundredths of Second
18.description: Hundredths of second portion of time between ping groups in ensemble.
18.comments: Part of TP command (time per ping). NOTE: WorkHorse extends ensemble if WP*TP > TE

19.name: coordinate_transformation_code
19.description: 8-bit coded field containing coordinate transformation processing parameters (EX command).
19.comments: Raw bit-coded coordinate transformation settings. See decoded_fields for individual parameters.

20.name: heading_alignment
20.description: Correction factor for physical heading misalignment.
20.comments: EA command sets heading alignment offset

21.name: heading_bias
21.description: Correction factor for electrical/magnetic heading bias.
21.comments: EB command sets heading bias correction

22.name: sensor_source_code
22.description: 8-bit coded field indicating selected source of environmental sensor data.
22.comments: Raw bit-coded sensor source. See decoded_fields for individual parameters.

23.name: sensor_available_code
23.description: 8-bit coded field indicating which sensors are available.
23.comments: Raw bit-coded sensor availability. See decoded_fields for individual parameters.

24.name: bin_1_distance
24.long_name: Distance to Bin 1 (Middle of First Depth Cell)
24.description: Distance to the middle of the first depth cell. Function of cell length, profiling mode, blanking distance, and sound speed.
24.comments: Calculated from WS, WM, WF, and sound speed

25.name: transmit_pulse_length
25.description: Length of the transmit pulse. Typically set equal to depth cell length.
25.comments: WT command sets transmit pulse length

26.name: water_profile_reference_layer
26.description: Starting (LSB) and ending (MSB) depth cell indices used for water reference layer averaging.
26.comments: WL command sets reference layer cells

27.name: false_target_threshold
27.description: Threshold value used to reject data from false targets (usually fish).

28.name: spare_1
28.description: Reserved/spare field for future use. Contains CX command setting (Range 0-5).

29.name: transmit_lag_distance
29.description: Represents output of ADC on DSP board. Fields are zeroed at deployment start and updated each ensemble.
29.comments: WM command reference; ADC samples one of 8 channels per ping

30.name: cpu_board_serial_number
30.description: Serial number of the CPU board. Stored in Big Endian (MSB first).

32.name: system_power
32.description: System power setting (CQ command setting). Range 0-255.
32.comments: CQ command for Monitor/Sentinel/Long Ranger ADCPs

34.name: instrument_serial_number
34.description: Contains the instrument (ADCP unit) serial number.

35.name: beam_angle
35.description: Acoustic beam angle relative to vertical axis.
35.comments: Typically 15, 20, or 30 degrees. Fixed for deployment.

3_1.name: frequency
3_1.description: Operating acoustic frequency of the ADCP.

bit_extraction.method: Extract bits 15-13, shift right by 13, map to frequency
bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].
bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert system_configuration_code to 16-bit binary string, extract indices [13:16], convert to integer, map to frequency value.

3_1.comments: Acoustic operating frequency. Typically constant within file.

3_2.name: beam_pattern
3_2.description: 1 = Concave beam pattern, 2 = Convex beam pattern

bit_extraction.method: Extract bit 12, map to beam pattern
bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].
bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert system_configuration_code to 16-bit binary string, extract index [12:13], map: 0→1 (concave), 1→2 (convex).

3_3.name: sensor_configuration

bit_extraction.method: Extract bits 11-10 from 16-bit binary representation and map to sensor configuration code
bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].
bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert system_configuration_code to 16-bit binary string, extract indices [4:8], convert to integer, map to beam angle value.

3_3.comments: Identifies which sensor set is installed.

3_4.name: transducer_attached
3_4.description: Indicates whether transducer head is physically attached.

bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].
bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert system_configuration_code to 16-bit binary string, extract indices [0:4], convert to integer, map to configuration code.

3_5.name: beam_direction
3_5.description: Direction beams are oriented (upward or downward looking).

bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].

3_5.comments: Down-looking: measuring from water surface down. Up-looking: measuring upward.

3_6.name: beam_angle_code

bit_extraction.method: Extract bits 7-4 from 16-bit binary representation and map to beam angle value
bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].

3_6.comments: Code maps to actual beam angle value (see beam_angle field for numeric value).

3_7.name: janus_configuration

bit_extraction.method: Extract bits 3-0 and map to enumeration code
bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=15 to LSB=0. For 16-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [16-1-N:16-N].

3_7.comments: Janus configuration defines beam arrangement (4-beam vs 5-beam systems).

19_1.name: coordinate_system

bit_extraction.method: Extract bits 7-6 and map to enumeration code

19_1.comments: Determines reference frame for velocity components.

19_2.name: use_tilt_correction
19_2.description: Flag indicating whether tilt correction is applied.
19_2.comments: Controls pitch/roll (tilt) correction in coordinate transformation.

19_3.name: three_beam_solution
19_3.comments: Allows velocity calculation using only 3 beams when 4th beam is unavailable.

19_4.name: bin_mapping_applied
19_4.description: Flag indicating whether bin mapping/remapping is applied.
19_4.comments: Controls whether data bins are remapped for aligned coordinates.

22_1.name: sensor_source_sound_speed

bit_extraction.bit_indexing_method: Traditional MSB=7 to LSB=0. For 8-bit values, bit positions map to string indices: bit N → string index [8-1-N:8-N].
bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert sensor_source_code to 8-bit binary string, extract bit 0, map: 0→0 (manual/internal), 1→1 (sensor/external).

22_1.comments: Determines whether sound speed is manually entered or sensor-derived.

bit_extraction.implementation_method: Convert sensor_source_code to 8-bit binary string, extract bit 1, map: 0→0 (manual/internal), 1→1 (sensor/external).

notes.implementation: This metadata file supports both raw and decoded fields. Use raw_fields for direct binary values and decoded_fields for human-readable interpretations.
notes.coordinates: All fields refer to fixed leader ensemble number (implied). No time dimension; Fixed Leader is constant per deployment.
notes.cf_conventions: Metadata follows CF Conventions 1.10 standards with UDUNITS2 unit strings.
notes.netcdf_compliance: File can be exported to NetCDF4 as CF-compliant Dataset.
notes.byte_order: All fields are little-endian except cpu_board_serial_number (big-endian).
notes.derived_fields: Decoded fields are derived from raw fields and should be calculated at read time, not stored separately in memory-intensive xarray Dataset.
notes.backward_compatibility: Old code accessing raw values will continue to work via accessors. New code should use decoded fields for clarity.
